findings.text: the receipt named for the default lane does not show the default lane: it records the filter-cleared case, 5 tests collected with no deselection, because a named path clears the inherited default marker expression. The claim it is cited for is true and reproducible (named file with -m "not slow" -> 4/5 collected, 1 deselected; explicit node id -> 1 collected; both reproduced first-hand in job 1273983 steps B2 and B3) but its evidence lives only in slurm-receipts-1273974.out step 6a, which is not the file the record points at (manifest test_logs line 51). A later reader opening this file finds the opposite of what they were sent for.

the corrected paragraph's universal envelope "on every row the two differ by 10.1% to 12.6%" is refuted at its floor by the receipt it cites: 21985/51 differs by 5.87% (0.8397259 against 0.7931332) and 21989/55 by 7.53%, so two of six rows fall below the stated floor. The two quoted endpoints (12.6371% and 10.0964%) are the first and last rows, not the extremes. The same sentence is carried in the plan comment at docs/plans/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov.html:573; the floor should read 5.9%. Every other range in the paragraph recomputes exactly against the receipt.

justifications.durability: The repairs are guarded rather than asserted. The marked slow test is the durable fix for the default lane's measured cost; the added gate test_the_committed_receipt_agrees_with_its_own_stored_numbers reads the committed receipt and requires its self-claims on every row, and it demonstrably can fail (it failed 1 of 16 on the pre-regeneration receipt); the pair-receipt redraw refuses a banked legacy value that disagrees with its recomputation, and the artifacts regenerate from banked states through a named entry point rather than by hand. Residual: the collect receipts are ad-hoc text files with no command line recorded in them, so their provenance survives only in the run directory, and nothing in the repository ties those files to the claim they are cited for.
justifications.evidence: The central evidence is first-hand reproducible and I reproduced it: the gate module ran 16 passed in 8.10s in one all_debug CPU process (job 1273983, JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, the shared interpreter directly, no uv on the node); every implied radius, both ratios, the rescaled combination and the top-level commensurability block of docs/figures/constraint-augmented-newton-krylov/shafranov-discriminator/receipt.json recompute exactly from the receipt's own stored numbers (ROWS_FAILING_A_CHECK=0 over six rows), and the record's quoted ranges major_over_minor 1.43-1.58, implied_over_major 0.66-0.75 and rescaled_efit_combination 0.4515-0.6329 match my recomputation exactly (the pre-correction 1.29-1.43, 0.73-0.83 and 0.5010-0.6806 follow from the row's own major_radius_m). The regeneration is bounded as claimed: the imposed receipt has no diff across the three commits, the six state PNGs and the strip PNG are untouched, and the row-state JSON deltas are the commensurability block. Read as text, the six row-state SVGs carry unfilled line contours, a closed wall polyline and both null markers (axis and admitted X-point); the strip figure is an axes-bearing comparison chart of values, not a poloidal flux panel, so contours, wall and nulls do not apply to it. Two delivered-evidence defects keep this below 18: a receipt that does not carry the claim the record cites it for, and one stated envelope the receipt refutes at its floor.
justifications.fit: The work lands the repairs the two reviews queued in the plan's own idiom: the outcome is recorded as a comment in the section that owns the discriminator, the reversal of the earlier reading is named as a reversal in the sentence that depends on it, the corrected numbers are given as a moved/unmoved list, the landed record is cited by anchor, and the node leaves its driving followup open rather than absorbing it (the imposed directory's PNG rows still lack SVG companions, queued in the plan text). The record and the plan comment agree numerically with each other and with the receipt apart from the envelope in the second finding, and the two DIII-D collection errors the manifest attributes to a pre-existing import break are confirmed pre-existing at base 902f22db.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node was dispatched to repair the faults the two prior reviews of this lineage recorded, and each is repaired at its root rather than at its symptom. The projection receipt now carries projection_move_of_target (+5.212043657709664e-05 on 21978/35, the value preserved exactly) apart from the imposed receipt's reference_combination_gap (-0.1661677303599005 on 22086/43, untouched), with the legacy key removed; commensurability is now called with unit_check["major_radius_m"], and nova/equilibrium/observation.py:543 shows that value is sum(radial volume elements)/volume, the convention string's own radius, not the solved-state centroid it was handed before; the profile_normalisation.path text now matches its own stored numbers on all six rows (label "normalised", profile_implied_combination == normalised_combination, combination_shift nonzero); test_profile_amplitude_compensator_reaches_its_row carries @pytest.mark.slow at tests/test_forward_profile_arguments.py:212, verified first-hand. The record states its commensurability reversal as a reversal, with a moved/unmoved list whose every recomputable number I reproduced from the receipt.
justifications.scope_discipline: The union of c3f82561, db1ea7b4 and e41f4401 is 23 paths, every one inside the node's declared write paths (the two benchmark drivers, the two figure directories, one test module plus its new gate, the landed record, and one plan section). The neighbouring shafranov (imposed) receipt and figures are untouched; no other plan, no sprint state and no shared configuration is touched; the plan edit is a single appended comment div in the section that owns the work. Every commit carries a body (27, 13 and 10 non-blank body lines) and none carries an AI attribution or a trailer.
